name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.CircuitSAT.BruteForce.submissionProp
title: The brute-force WE submission satisfies the Submission proposition (no assumptions)
statement: The brute-force submission u for witness encryption for NAND-circuit SAT (128 inputs, 2^12 gates, lambda = kappa = 128) satisfies Spec P R u: with no premises, it is correct (decryption always returns the message) and false-statement secure (for every unsatisfiable circuit the encryptions of 0 and 1 are identical, so every adversary has advantage 0), and its cost is at most N.
